maria: Quick Q — where do I find TTFT p50/p95/p99 for customer prod-slice (region eu-west)? Need tokens/sec too, want to sanity-check new alert thresholds.
sam: Try Grafana -> latency-playbooks -> 'inference / TTFT by slice'. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/latency-playbooks?orgId=1
sam: For tokens/sec panel it's on the same dashboard, panel 'token throughput'.
lee: If you want direct PromQL for p95 TTFT:
lee: ```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket{env="prod",slice="prod-slice"}[5m])) by (le))
```
lee: tokens/sec: ```sum(rate(tokens_generated_total{env="prod",slice="prod-slice"}[1m]))``` 
tony: we currently alert p95 > 400ms for prod tier, p99 > 900ms. thinking of lowering p95 to 300ms for eu-west canary. opinions? @maria
maria: Can we reduce to 300ms for canary only? want fewer false positives while we test batching change.
sam: ok do canary. I'll open PR on alerting rules. Rules live in infra-monitoring repo -> prometheus/rules/latency.yaml
sam: sample alert rule to change:
sam: ```yaml
- alert: TTFTHighP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket{env="prod",slice=~"prod-slice|canary"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.3
  for: 5m
```
obs-bot: [alert] TTFTHighP95 fired on prod-slice eu-west (p95=0.45s) :rotating_light:
maria: saw the alert, thanks obs-bot. Sam, can you include a mute window during rollout?
sam: will add silence for 1h and tag owner=eng-runtime. PR in progress: https://git.internal/infra-monitoring/pulls/42
tony: Also sharing a Jaeger trace link for a sample slow request: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/abcd-ef01
maria: nice trace — span shows rpc->model load spike. cc @lee to see if caching changes helped.
lee: noted, I'll check KV cache metrics (cache_hit_ratio panel) and post numbers later.
maria: thanks all. I'll follow up after PR merges. :thumbsup:
